items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) with the Mahngericht
items.quote: Bestreiten Sie sie ganz oder zum Teil, teilen Sie dem Mahngericht innerhalb derselben Frist mit, dass Sie Widerspruch erheben; verwenden Sie dafür möglichst den beigelegten Vordruck.
items.computation: The Zustellungsvermerk shows personal delivery (übergeben) on 20.11.2026, a Friday. The two-week period for Widerspruch runs from this delivery. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the period starts on 21.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of weeks ends with the expiry of the day of the last week that bears the same name as the day on which the triggering event (delivery) occurred, i.e. a Friday. Two weeks after Friday 20.11.2026 is Friday 04.12.2026. 04.12.2026 is a Friday and not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so § 193 BGB does not shift it. The Widerspruch must reach the Mahngericht (Amtsgericht Beispielcoburg) by this date.

items.title: Pay the claimed amount directly to the claimant (if claim accepted)
items.quote: Halten Sie die Forderung für berechtigt, begleichen Sie die Summe samt laufender Zinsen binnen zwei Wochen seit Zustellung dieses Bescheids direkt bei der Antragstellerin.
items.computation: Same delivery date (20.11.2026, Friday) and same two-week computation as the Widerspruch deadline: start day excluded per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (starts 21.11.2026), period of weeks ends per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the second week bearing the same name as the delivery day, i.e. Friday 04.12.2026. This date is a weekday in Bavaria, no shift under § 193 BGB applies. Payment (plus accruing interest) must reach the claimant, Exempel Fitnesswelt GmbH & Co. KG, by this date.

warnings: The court explicitly states it has not reviewed the claim ('Das Gericht hat ihren Anspruch nicht geprüft') — verify with the claimant (Exempel Fitnesswelt GmbH & Co. KG) whether the underlying membership-fee debt and the Lastschrift return fee are actually justified before paying or letting the deadline pass, since an unanswered Mahnbescheid can lead to a Vollstreckungsbescheid and account seizure (Kontopfändung).

If you dispute the claim even partially, the safer action is to file the Widerspruch within the deadline using the enclosed form rather than simply paying, to preserve your right to contest it in court.
